newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Prasidha opens coffee plant.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Prasidha opens coffee plant.

text.p: A $25 million instant coffee making plant run by Indonesian trading firm PT Prasidha Aneka Niaga was officially opened on Monday near the East Java capital of Surabaya.

Prasidha vice-president director Jeffry Soedargo said in a speech at the opening of the plant in Sidoarjo, East Java, that the firm hoped to produce 3,600 tonnes of instant coffee and 2,400 tonnes of ground coffee annually.
Agriculture Minister Syarifuddin Baharsyah presided over the dispatch of the first two containers of instant coffee to be exported to Japan.

The plant is a joint venture between Prasidha, which owns 65 percent, Itochu Corp of Japan with 20 percent, local company PT Citra Buana Tunggal Prakasa with 10 percent and Ueshima Coffee Company of Japan with five percent.
